tests.detail: redacted: 'email [EMAIL], I have depression an[MEDICAL]y is low[FINANCIAL]'
raw text encrypted at rest (no plaintext 'cancer' on disk)
privacy module has no remote/LLM imports
attacker without the salt cannot compute the pseudonym; no ID embedded
no unredacted PII in the encrypted raw store
no network/LLM imports in the privacy module
raw text not retained when not provided (data minimization)
different salt -> different pseudonym (no cross-study linkage)

conclusion: The privacy pipeline is hardened: PII/sensitive content is detected and redacted; data is minimized (embeddings, not raw text); IDs are pseudonymized (non-reversible without the encrypted salt); raw text is encrypted at rest; access is audited; deletion is complete; and there is NO remote telemetry and NO external LLM. The red team could not recover identity, leak PII, transmit remotely, retain raw thoughts, or link across studies.
